cityEdition: El Viejo San Juan: EUC Thrills by VibezZzCoder — https://github.com/VibezZzCoder/euc-sanjuan
note: Skatepark del Muelle: geometry kit and park shapes adapted from the San Francisco edition of EUC Thrills (MIT: VibezZzCoder, with Kamil's slop-sanfrancisco and Mr.doob's slop-newyork inheritance) and from the original EUC Thrills game (MIT: VibezZzCoder). Each entry records a San Juan file, the donor source files with their bytes and hashes at the pinned commits, and the San Juan file's hash. The listed public release has identical bytes for the San Francisco donor files.

files.derived: From sf-skatepark-geometry.js: the site frame rounded once to Float32, support facets made from the drawn triangles, contour-partitioned inscribed bodies (heightStripes/inscribedBodies) and wheel-sweep bar boxes. From skateparkLevel.ts: wallProfile (eased-foot transition), easedRamp and smin. New for San Juan: tensor-grid height fields with per-cell diagonals, skirts, level flagged lips, flat polygon floors and per-vertex/per-triangle paint.

Shapes and dimensions after the original game's Foundry Yard (rounded-rectangle bowl driven by one wall profile with a roll-out, the kicker with a level flagged lip and 0.10 m back drop, the 7 × 7 m pyramid, the five-riser stair set, the euro gap) and the SF edition's revised parks (opposing quarters with lip decks and outer banks, a clear spine, an exact on-park arrival). The layout, site fit, paint, guards, openings, lettering and flag were written for San Juan.
The low-amplitude value-noise concrete grain of createSkateparkMaterial; the joint grid and the procedural bowl and berm paint were written for San Juan.
